summary.text: Jenny Meltzer is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 73, which she has represented since November 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia, which lists her as Jennifer Meltzer, shows Democrat Allen Miller as her opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Meltzer was born in Toledo, Ohio, and lives in Shelbyville, Indiana.

She earned a bachelor's degree in psychology from Xavier University in 2006 and a law degree from the Indiana University McKinney School of Law in 2009, and she has worked as a city attorney for the City of Shelbyville.
Meltzer took office on November 9, 2022, succeeding J. Michael Davisson.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her as vice chair of the Courts and Criminal Code Committee and as a member of the House Judiciary and House Local Government committees.
